Daily Protein Needs Estimator

Estimate how many grams of protein per day fit broad reference ranges for your body weight and activity level. These are educational estimates, not a prescription.

Educational estimates only. Results are not medical advice, a diagnosis, or a treatment plan. Talk to a qualified healthcare professional about your health. Read the full medical disclaimer.

How to use this calculator

  1. Choose kilograms or pounds and enter your body weight.
  2. Pick the description closest to your activity.
  3. Press Calculate to see grams per day and how it was worked out.

The formulas

Protein per day (g) = body weight (kg) × grams per kg per day.

Reference assumptions
Groupg per kg per day
General adult reference0.8
Recreationally active1.0–1.2
Strength or muscle training1.2–1.6

The values are in assets/js/core.js (PROTEIN) if you want to edit them.

Important context

Protein needs vary with age, health, pregnancy, kidney disease and other circumstances, and more protein is not always better. This page does not recommend supplements or diets.

Frequently asked questions

How much protein do I need per day?

A common general reference for healthy adults is about 0.8 g per kg of body weight per day. Needs can be higher for some active people and different for others. This tool gives only a broad estimate.

Is more protein always better?

No. Needs differ between people, and some medical conditions call for limiting protein. Ask a professional if you are unsure.

Should I use my goal weight or current weight?

This estimator uses the weight you enter. Enter current body weight for a simple estimate and speak with a professional for personal planning.

Who should not rely on this?

People who are pregnant, have kidney disease or another medical condition, or are older should get individual advice from a healthcare professional.
